records.literal_gloss: Of David. To you, YHWH, my soul I lift up.

en.L: Of David. To {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, I lift up my soul.
en.B: Of David. To {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, I lift up my whole self.
en.R: By David. {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, I turn my whole heart to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} and pray.

fr.L: De David. Vers {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, j’élève mon âme.
fr.B: De David. Vers {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, j’élève tout mon être.
fr.R: De David. {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, je tourne tout mon cœur vers {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} et je prie.

sw.L: Ya Daudi. Kwako, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, ninainua nafsi yangu.
sw.B: Ya Daudi. Kwako, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, ninainua nafsi yangu yote.
sw.R: Ya Daudi. {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, ninakugeukia kwa moyo wangu wote na kuomba.

es.L: De David. A {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, elevo mi alma.
es.B: De David. A {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, elevo todo mi ser.
es.R: De David. {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, vuelvo hacia {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} todo mi corazón y oro.

vi.L: Của Đa-vít. Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, tôi nâng linh hồn tôi lên cùng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Của Đa-vít. Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, tôi dâng trọn con người tôi lên {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Của Đa-vít. Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, tôi hết lòng hướng về {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và cầu nguyện.

ko.L: 다윗의 [시]. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 주님께 제가 제 영혼을 들어 올립니다.
ko.B: 다윗의 시. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 제가 주님께 제 온 마음을 올려 드립니다.
ko.R: 다윗이 지은 노래. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 저는 온 마음을 주님께 향하고 기도합니다.

pt.L: De Davi. A {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}, {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, a minha alma eu levanto.
pt.B: De Davi. A {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}, {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, ergo todo o meu ser.
pt.R: De Davi. {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, eu me volto para {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} de todo o coração e oro.

am.L: የዳዊት። {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ ነፍሴን ወደ አንተ አነሣለሁ።
am.B: የዳዊት። {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ ሁለንተናዬን ወደ አንተ አነሣለሁ።
am.R: ዳዊት የዘመረው። {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ በሙሉ ልቤ ወደ አንተ ዞሬ እጸልያለሁ።

hi.L: दाऊद का। हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, मैं अपना प्राण तेरी ओर उठाता हूँ।
hi.B: दाऊद का। हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, मैं अपना पूरा अस्तित्व तेरी ओर उठाता हूँ।
hi.R: दाऊद का लिखा हुआ। हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, मैं अपना पूरा मन तेरी ओर लगाकर प्रार्थना करता हूँ।

ru.L: Давида. К {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}}, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, возношу я душу мою.
ru.B: Давида. К {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}}, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, я устремляюсь всем своим существом.
ru.R: Написал Давид. {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, всем сердцем я обращаюсь к {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}} и молюсь.

ja.L: ダビデによる。あなたに、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}よ、わたしは自分の魂を上げる。
ja.B: ダビデによる。{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}よ、あなたに向かって、わたしは自分のすべてを差し出す。
ja.R: ダビデによる。{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}よ、わたしは心のすべてをあなたに向けて、祈る。

decisions.choice: The title shares verse 1
decisions.reason: This psalm's title is short and the Hebrew counts it together with the first line as verse 1, so here the verse numbers are the same as in Bibles that print the title without a number.

decisions.choice: Psalm 25: an alphabet poem
decisions.reason: The psalm is an acrostic: its verses begin with the letters of the Hebrew alphabet in order, one letter to a verse. The pattern is not exact: one or two letters are missing or repeated, and a last verse beginning with the letter pe (verse 22) stands outside the alphabet, as the last verse of Psalm 34 does.

decisions.choice: I lift up my soul: I long for you, I pray to you
decisions.reason: To lift up the soul to someone is to set one's desire and hope on them (86:4; 143:8); the word for soul (nefesh) also means desire. The psalm opens as a prayer of trust.

decisions.choice: my whole self
decisions.reason: Balanced says what "soul" means here, the whole person (m3).

decisions.choice: I turn my whole heart to you and pray
decisions.reason: Readable says what the idiom means (m3).

decisions.choice: The alphabet pattern of Psalm 25 is not reproduced in Korean
alternatives: beginning verses with the Korean letters in order
decisions.reason: Psalm 25 is an alphabet poem in the Hebrew (meaning decision m2); as in Psalms 9-10, Korean leaves the pattern to the notes rather than bend the wording.

decisions.choice: no attempt at an alphabet poem
decisions.reason: The Hebrew verses begin with the letters of the alphabet in order (m2). Portuguese cannot keep the pattern without bending the sense, and the English does not imitate it either; the meaning note tells the reader it is there.

decisions.choice: No deity_pronoun spans in the Amharic of Psalm 25.
decisions.reason: The Ethiopic script has no capital letters, so the setting that capitalises pronouns for God has nothing to change in Amharic; pronouns and verb forms for God are written plainly.

decisions.choice: no deity_pronoun spans
decisions.reason: Devanagari has no capital letters, so the setting the English offers has nothing to change in Hindi. The psalm speaks to God with the devotional तू and about him with the honorific plural (वे).

decisions.choice: the alphabet pattern is not reproduced
decisions.reason: The Hebrew verses begin with the letters of the alphabet in order (m2). Hindi cannot copy the pattern without bending the sense, so the verses follow their meaning; the meaning decision explains the form.

decisions.choice: "Написал Давид"
decisions.reason: Where the title is only "Of David", Readable says "Написал Давид" for the English "By David", because a bare genitive does not read as a title in Russian; Literal and Balanced keep "Давида".

decisions.choice: The alphabet pattern of Psalm 25 (each verse starting with the next Hebrew letter) is not imitated in Japanese
alternatives: いろは順に行頭をそろえる
decisions.reason: The acrostic (m2) belongs to the Hebrew letters; imitating it with the iroha or the kana order would force the wording. Each verse is translated for its sense; the meaning decisions note the pattern.

decisions.choice: nafshi 'essa' "自分の魂を上げる" (L), "自分のすべてを差し出す" (B), "心のすべてをあなたに向けて、祈る" (R)
decisions.reason: To lift up the soul is to long for God and pray to him (m3); Balanced follows the English "my whole self", Readable the English Readable.

source.text: אֱֽלֹהַ֗י בְּךָ֣ בָ֭טַחְתִּי אַל־אֵב֑וֹשָׁה אַל־יַֽעַלְצ֖וּ אֹיְבַ֣י לִֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: My God, in you I trust; let me not be put to shame; let not my enemies exult over me.

en.L: My God, in {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} I trust; let me not be put to shame; let not my enemies exult over me.
en.B: My God, I trust in {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}; do not let me be disgraced, and do not let my enemies gloat over me.
en.R: My God, I trust {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}. Do not let me end up ashamed. Do not let my enemies laugh at me and celebrate.

fr.L: Mon Dieu, en {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} je me confie ; que je ne sois pas couvert de honte ; que mes ennemis ne triomphent pas de moi.
fr.B: Mon Dieu, je compte sur {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} ; ne me laisse pas tomber dans la honte, et ne laisse pas mes ennemis se réjouir à mes dépens.
fr.R: Mon Dieu, je {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} fais confiance. Ne me laisse pas finir dans la honte. Ne laisse pas mes ennemis rire de moi et faire la fête.

sw.L: Mungu wangu, {{deity_pronoun:kwako|Kwako}} ninatumaini; nisiaibishwe; adui zangu wasishangilie juu yangu.
sw.B: Mungu wangu, ninakutumaini; usiniache niaibike, wala usiwaache adui zangu wanicheke kwa ushindi.
sw.R: Mungu wangu, ninakutumaini. Usiniache niishie kuaibika. Usiwaache adui zangu wanicheke na kusherehekea.

es.L: Dios mío, en {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} confío; que no quede yo avergonzado; que mis enemigos no se jacten sobre mí.
es.B: Dios mío, confío en {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}; no dejes que me deshonren, y no dejes que mis enemigos se burlen de mí con aire de triunfo.
es.R: Dios mío, confío en {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}. No dejes que termine avergonzado. No dejes que mis enemigos se rían de mí y celebren.

vi.L: Lạy Đức Chúa Trời của tôi, tôi tin cậy nơi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; xin đừng để tôi bị hổ thẹn; xin đừng để kẻ thù tôi hớn hở vì tôi.
vi.B: Lạy Đức Chúa Trời của tôi, tôi tin cậy nơi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; xin đừng để tôi bị sỉ nhục, và đừng để kẻ thù đắc chí trên tôi.
vi.R: Lạy Đức Chúa Trời của tôi, tôi tin cậy {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Xin đừng để tôi phải xấu hổ. Xin đừng để kẻ thù cười nhạo và ăn mừng vì tôi.

ko.L: 저의 하나님, 제가 주님을 신뢰하니, 제가 부끄러움을 당하지 않게 하시고, 제 원수들이 저를 이기고 기뻐하지 않게 하십시오.
ko.B: 저의 하나님, 제가 주님을 의지합니다. 제가 수치를 당하지 않게 하시고, 제 원수들이 저를 보고 우쭐대지 않게 해 주십시오.
ko.R: 저의 하나님, 저는 주님을 믿습니다. 제가 부끄러운 일을 당하지 않게 해 주십시오. 제 원수들이 저를 비웃으며 기뻐하지 못하게 해 주십시오.

pt.L: Meu Deus, em {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} eu confio; que eu não fique envergonhado; que os meus inimigos não festejem sobre mim.
pt.B: Meu Deus, eu confio em {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}; não permitas que eu seja humilhado, nem que os meus inimigos se vangloriem da minha queda.
pt.R: Meu Deus, eu confio em {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}. Não deixes que eu acabe envergonhado. Não deixes os meus inimigos rirem de mim e comemorarem.

am.L: አምላኬ፣ በአንተ ታምኛለሁ፤ አልፈር፤ ጠላቶቼም በእኔ ላይ ሐሤት አያድርጉ።
am.B: አምላኬ ሆይ፣ በአንተ እታመናለሁ፤ አታዋርደኝ፤ ጠላቶቼም በእኔ ላይ እንዲፎክሩ አትፍቀድ።
am.R: አምላኬ ሆይ፣ በአንተ እታመናለሁ። አታሳፍረኝ። ጠላቶቼ እንዲስቁብኝና እንዲደሰቱብኝ አትፍቀድ።

hi.L: हे मेरे परमेश्वर, तुझ पर मैं भरोसा रखता हूँ; मुझे लज्जित न होने दे; मेरे शत्रु मुझ पर जयजयकार न करें।
hi.B: हे मेरे परमेश्वर, मैं तुझ पर भरोसा रखता हूँ; मुझे अपमानित न होने दे, और मेरे शत्रुओं को मुझ पर इतराने न दे।
hi.R: हे मेरे परमेश्वर, मैं तुझ पर भरोसा करता हूँ। ऐसा न हो कि अंत में मुझे शर्मिंदा होना पड़े। मेरे शत्रुओं को मुझ पर हँसने और ख़ुशी मनाने न दे।

ru.L: Боже мой, на {{deity_pronoun:тебя|Тебя}} я уповаю; да не буду я посрамлён; да не торжествуют надо мной враги мои.
ru.B: Боже мой, я полагаюсь на {{deity_pronoun:тебя|Тебя}}; не дай мне быть опозоренным, и не дай моим врагам злорадствовать надо мной.
ru.R: Боже мой, я доверяю {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}}. Не дай мне остаться в стыде. Не дай моим врагам смеяться надо мной и праздновать победу.

ja.L: わたしの神よ、あなたに、わたしは信頼する。わたしが恥を見ることのないようにしてください。わたしの敵が、わたしに向かって勝ち誇ることのないようにしてください。
ja.B: わたしの神よ、わたしはあなたに信頼する。わたしに恥をかかせないでください。敵が、わたしのことで勝ち誇らないようにしてください。
ja.R: わたしの神よ、わたしはあなたに信頼している。わたしが恥ずかしい思いをしないようにしてください。敵が、わたしを笑って大喜びすることがないようにしてください。

decisions.choice: be put to shame: be let down, disgraced
decisions.reason: The verb (bosh) is the shame of a hope that fails: the one who trusted is shown up as a fool before others. The psalm asks three times that this not happen (verses 2, 3, 20).

decisions.choice: My God: the alphabet pattern bends
decisions.reason: The verse should begin with the second letter of the alphabet (bet). It begins with "My God", and the bet word ("in you") comes next; the address to God may have been placed in front.

decisions.choice: exult over me: gloat in triumph
decisions.reason: The verb ('alats) is open rejoicing; over a fallen enemy it is gloating.

decisions.choice: "be put to shame" as "አፈረ" (L "አልፈር"), "አዋረደ" (B), "አሳፈረ" (R)
decisions.reason: The word is hope let down and disgraced before others (meaning decision m1); the same verb recurs in verses 3 and 20 and keeps these forms.

decisions.choice: 'al-'evoshah "恥を見ることのないようにしてください" (L), "恥をかかせないでください" (B), "恥ずかしい思いをしないようにしてください" (R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew is a first-person wish (let me not be shamed, m1); every level makes it a request to God in the Psalter's request form, 〜ようにしてください (L, R) / 〜ないでください (B).

source.text: גַּ֣ם כָּל־קֹ֭וֶיךָ לֹ֣א יֵבֹ֑שׁוּ יֵ֝בֹ֗שׁוּ הַבּוֹגְדִ֥ים רֵיקָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: Indeed all who wait for you will not be put to shame; they will be put to shame, those acting treacherously without cause.

en.L: Indeed, none who wait for {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} will be put to shame; they will be put to shame who act treacherously without cause.
en.B: Indeed, everyone who waits for {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} will be spared disgrace; it is those who betray others for nothing who will be disgraced.
en.R: People who wait for {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} to act will never be let down. But people who are disloyal for no reason will be put to shame.

fr.L: Oui, aucun de ceux qui {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}attendent ne sera couvert de honte ; ils seront couverts de honte, ceux qui trahissent sans raison.
fr.B: Oui, tous ceux qui {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}attendent seront gardés de la honte ; ce sont ceux qui trahissent les autres pour rien qui connaîtront la honte.
fr.R: Ceux qui attendent que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} agisses ne seront jamais déçus. Mais ceux qui sont déloyaux sans raison seront couverts de honte.

sw.L: Naam, hakuna kati ya wanaokungoja atakayeaibishwa; wataaibishwa wale watendao hila bila sababu.
sw.B: Naam, kila anayekungoja ataepushwa na aibu; ni wale wanaowasaliti wengine bure ndio watakaoaibishwa.
sw.R: Watu wanaokungoja utende hawatakatishwa tamaa kamwe. Lakini watu wasio waaminifu bila sababu wataaibishwa.

es.L: Ciertamente ninguno de los que {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} esperan será avergonzado; serán avergonzados los que actúan con traición sin motivo.
es.B: Sí, todo el que {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} espera se librará de la deshonra; son los que traicionan a otros porque sí los que quedarán deshonrados.
es.R: Los que esperan que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} actúes nunca quedarán defraudados. Pero los que son desleales sin razón quedarán en vergüenza.

vi.L: Thật vậy, không ai trông đợi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ bị hổ thẹn; những kẻ phản bội vô cớ mới bị hổ thẹn.
vi.B: Thật vậy, ai trông đợi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ không bị sỉ nhục; chính những kẻ phản bội người khác vô cớ mới bị sỉ nhục.
vi.R: Những người chờ đợi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ra tay sẽ không bao giờ thất vọng. Nhưng những kẻ bội bạc vô cớ sẽ bị xấu hổ.

ko.L: 참으로 주님을 기다리는 사람은 아무도 부끄러움을 당하지 않고, 까닭 없이 배신하는 자들이 부끄러움을 당할 것입니다.
ko.B: 주님을 기다리는 사람은 누구나 수치를 면할 것이고, 이유 없이 남을 배신하는 자들이 수치를 당할 것입니다.
ko.R: 주님께서 일하시기를 기다리는 사람은 결코 실망하지 않을 것입니다. 그러나 이유 없이 배신하는 사람들은 부끄러움을 당할 것입니다.

pt.L: Sim, nenhum dos que esperam em {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} ficará envergonhado; envergonhados ficarão os que agem com traição sem motivo.
pt.B: De fato, todos os que esperam por {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} serão poupados da vergonha; os humilhados serão os que traem os outros sem razão.
pt.R: Quem espera que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} ajas nunca vai se decepcionar. Mas quem é desleal sem motivo vai passar vergonha.

am.L: በእርግጥ አንተን በተስፋ የሚጠብቁ ሁሉ አያፍሩም፤ ያለ ምክንያት የሚያታልሉ እነርሱ ያፍራሉ።
am.B: በእርግጥ አንተን የሚጠብቁ ሁሉ ከውርደት ይድናሉ፤ የሚዋረዱት ያለ ምክንያት ሌሎችን የሚከዱ ናቸው።
am.R: አንተ እስክትሠራ የሚጠብቁ ሰዎች ከቶ አያፍሩም። ያለ ምክንያት ታማኝነት የሚያጎድሉ ሰዎች ግን ያፍራሉ።

hi.L: सचमुच, जो कोई तेरी बाट जोहते हैं, उनमें से कोई लज्जित न होगा; लज्जित वे होंगे जो बिना कारण विश्वासघात करते हैं।
hi.B: सचमुच, जो कोई तेरी बाट जोहता है, वह अपमान से बचा रहेगा; अपमानित तो वे होंगे जो बेवजह दूसरों से विश्वासघात करते हैं।
hi.R: जो लोग इस बात की राह देखते हैं कि तू कुछ करेगा, वे कभी निराश नहीं होंगे। पर जो लोग बिना किसी कारण धोखा देते हैं, उन्हें शर्मिंदा होना पड़ेगा।

ru.L: Поистине, никто из ожидающих {{deity_pronoun:тебя|Тебя}} не будет посрамлён; посрамлены будут те, кто вероломствует без причины.
ru.B: Поистине, каждый, кто ждёт {{deity_pronoun:тебя|Тебя}}, избежит позора; опозорены будут те, кто предаёт других ни за что.
ru.R: Люди, которые ждут, когда {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} начнёшь действовать, никогда не будут разочарованы. А те, кто без всякой причины поступает нечестно, будут опозорены.

ja.L: まことに、あなたを待ち望む者はだれも恥を見ない。恥を見るのは、理由もなく裏切る者たちである。
ja.B: まことに、あなたを待ち望む人はみな、恥を受けることがない。恥を受けるのは、理由もなく人を裏切る者たちだ。
ja.R: あなたが助けてくださるのを待つ人は、決してがっかりさせられない。しかし、理由もなく人を裏切る人たちは、恥をかく。

decisions.choice: wait for: hope in, look to with expectation
decisions.reason: To wait (qavah) for God is to look to him with hope and keep expecting him to act (27:14; Isaiah 40:31). The word returns in verses 5 and 21.

decisions.choice: act treacherously without cause: betray for no reason
decisions.reason: The verb (bagad) is breaking faith with someone one is bound to; "without cause" (reqam) means for nothing, with no wrong done to them.

decisions.choice: will not be put to shame: a confident statement
alternatives: let none ... be put to shame (a wish)
decisions.reason: The verbs can be read as a statement or as a wish; read as a statement, the verse gives the ground for the prayer of verse 2.

decisions.choice: qoveykha "あなたを待ち望む者" (L), "あなたを待ち望む人" (B), "あなたが助けてくださるのを待つ人" (R); qavah "待ち望む" for the Psalter
decisions.reason: To wait for God is to hope in him and look to him with expectation (m1); 待ち望む carries both, and Readable spells out what is awaited as the English Readable.

source.text: דְּרָכֶ֣יךָ יְ֭הוָה הוֹדִיעֵ֑נִי אֹ֖רְחוֹתֶ֣יךָלַמְּדֵֽנִי׃

records.literal_gloss: Your ways, YHWH, make me know; your paths teach me.

en.L: Your ways, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, make known to me; {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} paths teach me.
en.B: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, let me come to know {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} ways; teach me to follow {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} paths.
en.R: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, show me how {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} want me to live. Teach me which road to take.

fr.L: Tes voies, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, fais-[les]-moi connaître ; {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} sentiers, enseigne-[les]-moi.
fr.B: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, fais-moi connaître {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} voies ; apprends-moi à suivre {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} sentiers.
fr.R: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, montre-moi comment {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} veux que je vive. Apprends-moi quel chemin prendre.

sw.L: Njia {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}}, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, unijulishe; mapito {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} unifundishe.
sw.B: Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, unijalie kuzijua njia {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}}; unifundishe kufuata mapito {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, unionyeshe jinsi unavyotaka niishi. Unifundishe njia ya kufuata.

es.L: Tus caminos, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, hazme conocer; {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} sendas enséñame.
es.B: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, déjame llegar a conocer {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} caminos; enséñame a seguir {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} sendas.
es.R: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, muéstrame cómo quieres {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} que yo viva. Enséñame qué camino tomar.

vi.L: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, xin cho tôi biết đường lối {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; xin dạy tôi các nẻo đường của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, xin cho tôi biết đường lối {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; xin dạy tôi bước đi trên những nẻo đường của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, xin chỉ cho tôi biết {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} muốn tôi sống thế nào. Xin dạy tôi nên đi con đường nào.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 주님의 길들을 제게 알게 하시고, 주님의 오솔길들을 제게 가르쳐 주십시오.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 제가 주님의 길을 알게 해 주시고, 주님께서 가리키시는 길로 가도록 가르쳐 주십시오.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 주님께서 제가 어떻게 살기를 원하시는지 보여 주십시오. 어느 길로 가야 하는지 가르쳐 주십시오.

pt.L: Os {{deity_pronoun:teus|Teus}} caminhos, {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, dá-me a conhecer; as {{deity_pronoun:tuas|Tuas}} trilhas, ensina-me.
pt.B: {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, deixa-me conhecer os {{deity_pronoun:teus|Teus}} caminhos; ensina-me a seguir as {{deity_pronoun:tuas|Tuas}} trilhas.
pt.R: {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, mostra-me como {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} queres que eu viva. Ensina-me que estrada tomar.

am.L: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ መንገዶችህን አስታውቀኝ፤ ጎዳናዎችህን አስተምረኝ።
am.B: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ መንገዶችህን እንዳውቅ አድርገኝ፤ ጎዳናዎችህን እንድከተል አስተምረኝ።
am.R: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ እንዴት እንድኖር እንደምትፈልግ አሳየኝ። የትኛውን መንገድ እንደምይዝ አስተምረኝ።

hi.L: हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, अपने मार्ग मुझे बता; अपने पथ मुझे सिखा।
hi.B: हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, मुझे अपने मार्ग जानने दे; अपने पथों पर चलना मुझे सिखा।
hi.R: हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, मुझे दिखा कि तू मुझसे कैसा जीवन चाहता है। मुझे सिखा कि मैं कौन-सा रास्ता चुनूँ।

ru.L: Пути {{deity_pronoun:твои|Твои}}, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, дай мне познать; стезям {{deity_pronoun:твоим|Твоим}} научи меня.
ru.B: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, дай мне узнать {{deity_pronoun:твои|Твои}} пути; научи меня идти {{deity_pronoun:твоими|Твоими}} тропами.
ru.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, покажи мне, как {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} хочешь, чтобы я жил. Научи меня, по какой дороге идти.

ja.L: あなたの道を、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}よ、わたしに知らせてください。あなたの道筋を、わたしに教えてください。
ja.B: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}よ、あなたの道を、わたしに知らせてください。あなたの道筋を歩めるように、わたしを教えてください。
ja.R: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}よ、わたしがどのように生きることを、あなたが望んでおられるのか、示してください。どの道を行けばよいのか、教えてください。

decisions.choice: your ways, your paths: the life you approve
decisions.reason: God's ways and paths are the way of life he shows and wants people to walk in (Exodus 33:13; Psalm 27:11). The prayer is to be taught to live by them.

decisions.choice: to follow (B); which road to take (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable make plain that the teaching is for walking in these paths (m1).

decisions.choice: "Пути {{deity_pronoun:твои|Твои}}" with a span
alternatives: no span, as the English sentence-initial "Your"
decisions.reason: The English needs no span on a capitalised first word; Russian puts the noun first, so "твои" stands mid-sentence and takes the span like every other pronoun for God.

source.text: הַדְרִ֘יכֵ֤נִי בַאֲמִתֶּ֨ךָ׀וְֽלַמְּדֵ֗נִי כִּֽי־אַ֭תָּה אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׁעִ֑י אוֹתְךָ֥ קִ֝וִּ֗יתִי כָּל־הַיּֽוֹם׃

records.literal_gloss: Lead me in your truth and teach me, for you [are the] God of my salvation; for you I have waited all the day.

en.L: Lead me in {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} truth and teach me, for {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} [are the] God of my salvation; for {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} I have waited all the day.
en.B: Lead me by {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} faithfulness and teach me, since {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} are the God who saves me; it is {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} I wait for the whole day through.
en.R: Help me live by {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} truth, and teach me. You are my God, the one who saves me. I keep waiting for {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} all day.

fr.L: Conduis-moi dans {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} vérité et enseigne-moi, car {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} [es le] Dieu de mon salut ; c’est {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} que j’ai attendu tout le jour.
fr.B: Guide-moi par {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} fidélité et enseigne-moi, puisque {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} es le Dieu qui me sauve ; c’est {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} que j’attends du matin au soir.
fr.R: Aide-moi à vivre selon {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} vérité, et enseigne-moi. Tu es mon Dieu, celui qui me sauve. Je {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}attends toute la journée.

sw.L: Uniongoze katika kweli {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} na unifundishe, kwa maana {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} [ndiwe] Mungu wa wokovu wangu; nimekungoja {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} mchana kutwa.
sw.B: Uniongoze kwa uaminifu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} na unifundishe, kwa kuwa {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} ndiwe Mungu anayeniokoa; ni {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} ninayekungoja siku nzima.
sw.R: Unisaidie kuishi kwa kweli {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}, na unifundishe. Wewe ni Mungu wangu, unayeniokoa. Ninaendelea kukungoja {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} mchana kutwa.

es.L: Guíame en {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} verdad y enséñame, porque {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} [eres el] Dios de mi salvación; a {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} he esperado todo el día.
es.B: Guíame por {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} fidelidad y enséñame, ya que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} eres el Dios que me salva; es a {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} a quien espero todo el día.
es.R: Ayúdame a vivir según {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} verdad, y enséñame. Tú eres mi Dios, el que me salva. Todo el día {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} espero.

vi.L: Xin dẫn tôi trong chân lý của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và dạy dỗ tôi, vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} [là] Đức Chúa Trời của sự cứu rỗi tôi; tôi đã trông đợi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} suốt ngày.
vi.B: Xin dẫn tôi bằng sự thành tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và dạy dỗ tôi, vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là Đức Chúa Trời, Đấng cứu rỗi tôi; chính {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là Đấng tôi trông đợi suốt cả ngày.
vi.R: Xin giúp tôi sống theo chân lý của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, và dạy dỗ tôi. Ngài là Đức Chúa Trời của tôi, Đấng cứu tôi. Tôi cứ trông đợi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} suốt ngày.

ko.L: 주님의 진실로 저를 이끄시고 가르쳐 주십시오. 주님은 저의 구원의 하나님이시니, 제가 온종일 주님을 기다렸습니다.
ko.B: 주님의 신실하심으로 저를 이끄시고 가르쳐 주십시오. 주님은 저를 구원하시는 하나님이시니, 제가 온종일 기다리는 분은 주님이십니다.
ko.R: 주님의 진실하심을 따라 살도록 저를 도와주시고 가르쳐 주십시오. 주님은 저를 구원하시는 저의 하나님이십니다. 저는 온종일 주님을 기다립니다.

pt.L: Leva-me pela {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} verdade e ensina-me, porque {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} [és o] Deus da minha salvação; a {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} tenho esperado o dia inteiro.
pt.B: Conduz-me pela {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} fidelidade e ensina-me, já que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} és o Deus que me salva; é por {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} que espero o dia inteiro.
pt.R: Ajuda-me a viver pela {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} verdade e ensina-me. Tu és o meu Deus, aquele que me salva. Eu fico esperando por {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} o dia todo.

am.L: በእውነትህ ምራኝ፤ አስተምረኝም፤ አንተ የመዳኔ አምላክ [ነህ]ና፤ ቀኑን ሁሉ አንተን ጠብቄአለሁ።
am.B: በታማኝነትህ ምራኝ፤ አስተምረኝም፤ የምታድነኝ አምላክ አንተ ነህና፤ ቀኑን ሙሉ የምጠብቀው አንተን ነው።
am.R: በእውነትህ እንድኖር እርዳኝ፤ አስተምረኝም። አንተ አምላኬ ነህ፤ የምታድነኝም አንተ ነህ። ቀኑን ሙሉ አንተን እጠብቃለሁ።

hi.L: अपनी सच्चाई में मेरी अगुवाई कर और मुझे सिखा, क्योंकि तू मेरे उद्धार का परमेश्वर [है]; सारे दिन मैं तेरी ही बाट जोहता रहा हूँ।
hi.B: अपनी विश्वासयोग्यता से मेरी अगुवाई कर और मुझे सिखा, क्योंकि तू ही वह परमेश्वर है जो मुझे बचाता है; दिन भर मैं तेरी ही बाट जोहता रहता हूँ।
hi.R: अपने सत्य के अनुसार जीने में मेरी मदद कर, और मुझे सिखा। तू मेरा परमेश्वर है, जो मुझे बचाता है। मैं सारा दिन तेरी ही राह देखता रहता हूँ।

ru.L: Веди меня в истине {{deity_pronoun:твоей|Твоей}} и учи меня, ведь {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} — Бог спасения моего; на {{deity_pronoun:тебя|Тебя}} я надеялся весь день.
ru.B: Веди меня своей верностью и учи меня, ведь {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} — Бог, который меня спасает; именно {{deity_pronoun:тебя|Тебя}} я жду весь день напролёт.
ru.R: Помоги мне жить по {{deity_pronoun:твоей|Твоей}} истине и научи меня. Ты — мой Бог, тот, кто меня спасает. Я жду {{deity_pronoun:тебя|Тебя}} весь день.

ja.L: あなたのまことのうちにわたしを導き、わたしを教えてください。まことに、あなたはわたしの救いの神。あなたを、わたしは一日中待ち望んだ。
ja.B: あなたのまことによってわたしを導き、教えてください。あなたは、わたしを救ってくださる神だからだ。わたしが一日中待ち望んでいるのは、あなただ。
ja.R: あなたの真実に従って生きられるように、わたしを助け、教えてください。あなたは、わたしを救ってくださる、わたしの神だ。わたしは一日中、あなたを待ち続けている。

decisions.choice: your truth: your faithfulness, your reliable word
decisions.reason: The word ('emet) means what is firm and reliable: God's truth and his faithfulness are one. To be led in it is to live by what God has shown to be true and to rely on him to keep faith (verse 10; 26:3).

decisions.choice: God of my salvation: the God who saves me
decisions.reason: The phrase names God by what he does for the psalmist: he rescues him (27:9).

decisions.choice: for you I have waited: you, and no one else
decisions.reason: The object comes first for emphasis: the psalmist's hope is in God alone.

decisions.choice: the God who saves me
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what the phrase means (m2).

decisions.choice: "kweli" (truth) at Literal and Readable; "uaminifu" (faithfulness) at Balanced
decisions.reason: The Hebrew ʾemet is both truth and faithfulness, God's reliable word and way (m1). Swahili has the two words "kweli" and "uaminifu"; Balanced follows the English "faithfulness", the other levels "truth", so readers see both sides of the word.

decisions.choice: "chân lý" (L, R); "sự thành tín" (B)
decisions.reason: The word is God's truth and his faithfulness at once (see the meaning decision); Balanced brings out the faithfulness, as the English does, and the other levels keep the key word "chân lý".

decisions.choice: "진실" (L), "신실하심" (B), "진실하심" (R) for God's emet
decisions.reason: Terms note: the word is God's faithfulness and reliable word (meaning decision m1); "진리" would suggest truth as a body of teaching, the sense it has in John.

decisions.choice: "ታማኝነትህ" (your faithfulness) at Balanced; "እውነትህ" at Literal and Readable
decisions.reason: ʾemet is both truth and faithfulness (meaning decision m1); each level follows its English, as the Pentateuch terms list allows.

decisions.choice: सच्चाई (L); विश्वासयोग्यता (B)
decisions.reason: God's emet is his faithfulness and his reliable word (m1): Literal says सच्चाई, Balanced विश्वासयोग्यता, as the English "faithfulness"; Readable follows the English "truth" (सत्य).

decisions.choice: "истина" (L, R); "верность" (B)
decisions.reason: The word (emet) is both truth and faithfulness (m1); each level follows the English level's reading, as the poetry terms note allows.

decisions.choice: "своей верностью", no span
decisions.reason: In a request to God Russian may use the reflexive "свой", which takes no deity_pronoun span.

decisions.choice: 'emet "まこと" (L, B), "真実" (R)
decisions.reason: The word is God's faithfulness and his reliable word (m1, uncertain); the Psalter's まこと covers both at Literal and Balanced, and Readable says 真実 as the English "truth".

source.text: זְכֹר־רַחֲמֶ֣יךָ יְ֭הוָה וַחֲסָדֶ֑יךָ כִּ֖י מֵעוֹלָ֣ם הֵֽמָּה׃

records.literal_gloss: Remember your compassions, YHWH, and your loyal loves, for from of old they [are].

en.L: Remember {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} compassion, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, and {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} loyal love, for they [are] from of old.
en.B: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, keep in mind {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} tender mercies and {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} acts of loyal love; they have been {{deity_pronoun:yours|Yours}} since ancient times.
en.R: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, remember how kind and full of faithful love {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have always been. You have been that way from the very beginning.

fr.L: Souviens-{{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} de {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} compassion, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, et de {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} amour loyal, car ils [sont] depuis toujours.
fr.B: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, rappelle-{{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} tendre compassion et {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} gestes d’amour fidèle ; ils sont {{deity_pronoun:tiens|Tiens}} depuis les temps anciens.
fr.R: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, souviens-{{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} : {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as toujours été si bon et si plein d’amour fidèle. Tu as été ainsi depuis le tout début.

sw.L: Zikumbuke rehema {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}}, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, na upendo {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} usiokoma, kwa maana [ni] tangu zamani.
sw.B: Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kumbuka huruma {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}} nyororo na matendo {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} ya upendo usiokoma; ni {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} tangu nyakati za kale.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kumbuka jinsi ambavyo umekuwa mwema na mwenye upendo usiokoma siku zote. Umekuwa hivyo tangu mwanzo kabisa.

es.L: Acuérdate de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} compasión, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, y de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} amor leal, porque [son] desde la antigüedad.
es.B: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, ten presente {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} tierna misericordia y {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} actos de amor fiel; han sido {{deity_pronoun:tuyos|Tuyos}} desde tiempos antiguos.
es.R: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, acuérdate de lo bondadoso y lleno de amor fiel que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} has sido siempre. Has sido así desde el principio.

vi.L: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, xin nhớ lại lòng thương xót của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và tình yêu thương thành tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, vì chúng [có] từ thuở xưa.
vi.B: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, xin nhớ đến lòng thương xót dịu dàng và những việc yêu thương thành tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; từ ngàn xưa chúng vẫn là của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, xin nhớ rằng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} luôn nhân từ và đầy tình thương không hề thay đổi. Ngài vẫn luôn như thế ngay từ ban đầu.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 주님의 긍휼과 주님의 한결같은 사랑을 기억해 주십시오. 그것들은 옛날부터 있었습니다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 주님의 따뜻한 긍휼과 한결같은 사랑의 일들을 기억해 주십시오. 그것들은 아득한 옛날부터 주님의 것이었습니다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 주님께서 언제나 얼마나 친절하시고 변함없는 사랑으로 가득하셨는지 기억해 주십시오. 주님께서는 처음부터 그런 분이셨습니다.

pt.L: Lembra-{{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} da {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} compaixão, {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, e do {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} amor leal, pois [eles são] desde a antiguidade.
pt.B: {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, tem em mente as {{deity_pronoun:tuas|Tuas}} ternas misericórdias e os {{deity_pronoun:teus|Teus}} atos de amor leal; eles são {{deity_pronoun:teus|Teus}} desde os tempos antigos.
pt.R: {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, lembra-{{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} de como {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} sempre foste bondoso e cheio de amor fiel. Tu és assim desde o princípio.

am.L: ርኅራኄህን አስብ፣ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ ጽኑ ፍቅርህንም፤ ከጥንት ጀምሮ [ያሉ] ናቸውና።
am.B: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ ርኅራኄህንና የጽኑ ፍቅር ሥራዎችህን አስብ፤ ከጥንት ዘመን ጀምሮ የአንተ ናቸውና።
am.R: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ ሁልጊዜ ምን ያህል ርኅሩኅና በጽኑ ፍቅር የተሞላህ እንደ ነበርህ አስታውስ። ከመጀመሪያው ጀምሮ እንደዚህ ነበርህ።

hi.L: हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, अपनी दया और अपने अटल प्रेम को स्मरण कर, क्योंकि वे प्राचीन काल से [हैं]।
hi.B: हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, अपनी कोमल दया और अपने अटल प्रेम के कामों को याद रख; वे प्राचीन काल से तेरे ही हैं।
hi.R: हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, याद कर कि तू हमेशा कितना दयालु और अटल प्रेम से भरा रहा है। तू बिलकुल शुरू से ऐसा ही है।

ru.L: Вспомни {{deity_pronoun:твоё|Твоё}} сострадание, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, и {{deity_pronoun:твою|Твою}} неизменную любовь, ведь они — от века.
ru.B: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, вспомни {{deity_pronoun:твоё|Твоё}} нежное милосердие и дела {{deity_pronoun:твоей|Твоей}} неизменной любви; они {{deity_pronoun:твои|Твои}} с древних времён.
ru.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, вспомни, как добр {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} всегда был и как полон неизменной любви. Ты был таким с самого начала.

ja.L: あなたのあわれみを思い起こしてください、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}よ、またあなたの誠実を。それらはとこしえの昔から[ある]のだから。
ja.B: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}よ、あなたの深いあわれみと、いつくしみの数々を、心に留めてください。それらは、遠い昔からあなたのものなのだから。
ja.R: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}よ、あなたがこれまでずっと、どれほどやさしく、変わらぬいつくしみに満ちておられたかを、思い出してください。あなたは、初めからずっとそういう方だ。

decisions.choice: compassion: tender, motherly mercy
decisions.reason: The word (rachamim) is related to the word for womb: the love of a parent for a child (103:13; Isaiah 49:15). It is plural here, for its many acts.

decisions.choice: loyal love: love that keeps faith
decisions.reason: The word (chesed) is love that keeps its commitments, the faithful kindness of the covenant (Exodus 34:6-7). It is plural here: the many times God has shown it.

decisions.choice: Remember: act on what you know
decisions.reason: When God remembers, he acts on what he remembers (Genesis 8:1). The next verse turns the word around: do not remember my sins, but remember me.

decisions.choice: faithful love
decisions.reason: Readable's usual wording for chesed (m2).

decisions.choice: "compassion" (Literal), "tendre compassion" (Balanced)
decisions.reason: The word is tender, motherly mercy (m1); "compassion" is the plain modern French, and Balanced adds "tendre" to keep its warmth.

decisions.choice: "lòng thương xót" for compassion, beside "tình yêu thương thành tín"
decisions.reason: The psalm names two kinds of love side by side: tender, motherly mercy and love that keeps faith (see the meaning decisions). Vietnamese keeps two words for them.

decisions.choice: compassion "ርኅራኄ"; loyal love "ጽኑ ፍቅር" at every level, Readable included where the English says "faithful love"
decisions.reason: "ርኅራኄ" is the tender, motherly mercy of meaning decision m1; ḥesed as the terms list.

decisions.choice: अटल प्रेम (every level)
decisions.reason: God's hesed is अटल प्रेम at every level in the Psalms, where the English Readable says "faithful love". The Hebrew plurals (compassions, loyal loves) are said as Hindi says them, in the singular or as "acts of" (B).

decisions.choice: "сострадание" (L); "нежное милосердие" (B)
decisions.reason: The word (rahamim) is tender, motherly compassion (m1); the Slavonic "щедроты" now reads as generosity.

decisions.choice: rachamim "あわれみ" (L), "深いあわれみ" (B), "やさしく" (R); chasadim "誠実" (L), "いつくしみの数々" (B), "変わらぬいつくしみ" (R)
decisions.reason: Rachamim is tender, motherly mercy (m1), kept apart from chesed (m2); the plural chasadim, acts of loyal love, is いつくしみの数々 at Balanced as the Psalter's convention.

source.text: חַטֹּ֤אות נְעוּרַ֨י׀וּפְשָׁעַ֗י אַל־תִּ֫זְכֹּ֥ר כְּחַסְדְּךָ֥ זְכָר־לִי־אַ֑תָּה לְמַ֖עַן טוּבְךָ֣ יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: [The] sins of my youth and my transgressions do not remember; according to your loyal love remember me, you, for the sake of your goodness, YHWH.

en.L: The sins of my youth and my transgressions do not remember; according to {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} loyal love remember me — {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} — for the sake of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} goodness, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: Do not hold against me the sins of my youth or my acts of rebellion; in {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} loyal love remember me, for the sake of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} goodness, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: Do not keep thinking about the wrong things I did when I was young, or the times I turned against {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}. Think of me with {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} faithful love, because {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} are good, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}.

fr.L: Les péchés de ma jeunesse et mes transgressions, ne {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}en souviens pas ; selon {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} amour loyal souviens-{{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} de moi, {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, à cause de {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} bonté, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Ne retiens pas contre moi les péchés de ma jeunesse ni mes actes de révolte ; dans {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} amour fidèle, souviens-{{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} de moi, à cause de {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} bonté, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Ne pense plus au mal que j’ai fait quand j’étais jeune, ni aux fois où je me suis tourné contre {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}. Pense à moi avec {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} amour fidèle, parce que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} es bon, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Dhambi za ujana wangu na maasi yangu usiyakumbuke; kwa kadiri ya upendo {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} usiokoma unikumbuke — {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} — kwa ajili ya wema {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Usinihesabie dhambi za ujana wangu wala matendo yangu ya uasi; kwa upendo {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} usiokoma unikumbuke, kwa ajili ya wema {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Usiendelee kufikiria mabaya niliyoyatenda nilipokuwa kijana, wala nyakati nilipokuasi. Unikumbuke kwa upendo {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} usiokoma, kwa sababu {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} ni mwema, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

es.L: Los pecados de mi juventud y mis transgresiones no recuerdes; conforme a {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} amor leal acuérdate de mí, {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}}, por causa de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} bondad, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.B: No tengas en cuenta contra mí los pecados de mi juventud ni mis rebeliones; en {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} amor fiel acuérdate de mí, por causa de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} bondad, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.R: No sigas pensando en las cosas malas que hice cuando era joven, ni en las veces que me puse en contra de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}. Piensa en mí con {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} amor fiel, porque {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} eres bueno, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.

vi.L: Tội lỗi thời trẻ của tôi và những vi phạm của tôi, xin đừng nhớ đến; theo tình yêu thương thành tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, xin nhớ đến tôi, chính {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, vì cớ sự tốt lành của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.B: Xin đừng ghi nhớ những tội lỗi thời trẻ hay những lần phản nghịch của tôi; trong tình yêu thương thành tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, xin nhớ đến tôi, vì sự tốt lành của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.R: Xin đừng mãi nghĩ đến những điều sai trái tôi đã làm thời còn trẻ, hay những lần tôi chống lại {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Xin nghĩ đến tôi với tình thương không hề thay đổi của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là Đấng tốt lành, lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.

ko.L: 제 젊은 시절의 죄와 제 허물을 기억하지 마시고, 주님의 한결같은 사랑에 따라 저를 기억해 주십시오. 바로 주님께서, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 주님의 선하심 때문에 [그리해 주십시오].
ko.B: 제 젊은 날의 죄와 제 반역을 마음에 두지 마시고, 주님의 한결같은 사랑으로 저를 기억해 주십시오. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 주님의 선하심 때문입니다.
ko.R: 제가 젊었을 때 저지른 잘못과 주님께 등을 돌렸던 일들을 계속 생각하지 말아 주십시오. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 주님은 선하시니 변함없는 사랑으로 저를 생각해 주십시오.

pt.L: Dos pecados da minha juventude e das minhas rebeldias não {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} lembres; segundo o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} amor leal lembra-{{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} de mim — {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} — por causa da {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} bondade, {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}.
pt.B: Não leves em conta contra mim os pecados da minha juventude nem as minhas rebeldias; no {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} amor leal, lembra-{{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} de mim, por causa da {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} bondade, {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}.
pt.R: Não fiques pensando nas coisas erradas que eu fiz quando era jovem, nem nas vezes em que me revoltei contra {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}. Pensa em mim com o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} amor fiel, porque {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} és bom, {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}.

am.L: የወጣትነቴን ኃጢአቶችና መተላለፎቼን አታስብ፤ እንደ ጽኑ ፍቅርህ አንተ አስበኝ፤ ስለ መልካምነትህ፣ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ።
am.B: የወጣትነቴን ኃጢአቶችና ዓመፄን አትቁጠርብኝ፤ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ ስለ መልካምነትህ በጽኑ ፍቅርህ አስበኝ።
am.R: በወጣትነቴ የሠራኋቸውን ክፉ ነገሮችና በአንተ ላይ ያመፅኩባቸውን ጊዜያት ማሰብህን ተው። {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ አንተ መልካም ስለ ሆንክ በጽኑ ፍቅርህ አስበኝ።

hi.L: मेरी जवानी के पापों और मेरे अपराधों को स्मरण न कर; अपने अटल प्रेम के अनुसार मुझे स्मरण कर, तू ही, हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, अपनी भलाई के कारण।
hi.B: मेरी जवानी के पापों और मेरे विद्रोह के कामों को मेरे विरुद्ध न गिन; अपने अटल प्रेम में मुझे याद रख, अपनी भलाई के कारण, हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}।
hi.R: जो ग़लत काम मैंने जवानी में किए, और जब-जब मैं तेरे विरुद्ध गया, उन बातों को याद करता न रह। अपने अटल प्रेम से मुझे याद कर, क्योंकि तू भला है, हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}।

ru.L: Грехов юности моей и преступлений моих не вспоминай; по {{deity_pronoun:твоей|Твоей}} неизменной любви вспомни меня — {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} — ради {{deity_pronoun:твоей|Твоей}} благости, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}.
ru.B: Не ставь мне в вину грехов моей юности и моих мятежных поступков; в {{deity_pronoun:твоей|Твоей}} неизменной любви вспомни меня ради {{deity_pronoun:твоей|Твоей}} благости, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}.
ru.R: Не думай больше о плохом, что я делал в молодости, и о тех случаях, когда я восставал против {{deity_pronoun:тебя|Тебя}}. Подумай обо мне с {{deity_pronoun:твоей|Твоей}} неизменной любовью, потому что {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} добр, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}.

ja.L: わたしの若い時の罪と、わたしの背きを、思い起こさないでください。あなたの誠実にしたがって、あなたこそ、わたしを思い起こしてください、あなたの恵み深さのゆえに、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}よ。
ja.B: わたしの若いころの罪や背きを、わたしに負わせないでください。{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}よ、あなたの変わらぬいつくしみによって、わたしを心に留めてください。あなたの恵み深さのゆえに。
ja.R: わたしが若いころにした悪いことや、あなたに背いたことを、いつまでも思い出さないでください。{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}よ、あなたの変わらぬいつくしみをもって、わたしのことを思ってください。あなたは良い方なのだから。

decisions.choice: transgressions: acts of rebellion
decisions.reason: The word (pesha') is a breaking away from a lord, rebellion against God, not only missing the mark (chatta't, "sins").

decisions.choice: do not remember: do not hold against me
decisions.reason: For God not to remember sins is to forgive them and not act on them (Isaiah 43:25; Jeremiah 31:34).

decisions.choice: you: emphatic
decisions.reason: The pronoun "you" is added for emphasis: whatever others may do, you remember me.

decisions.choice: loyal love: love that keeps faith
decisions.reason: The word (chesed) is love that keeps its commitments, the faithful kindness of the covenant (Exodus 34:6-7).

decisions.choice: Do not hold against me
decisions.reason: Balanced says what the idiom means (m2).

decisions.choice: the times I turned against you
decisions.reason: Readable says what the word means and whom the rebellion was against (m1).

decisions.choice: तू ही
decisions.reason: The Hebrew adds an emphatic "you" (m3); Literal keeps it as तू ही, set off in the line as the English sets it off with dashes.

decisions.choice: 'attah "あなたこそ" placed before the request (L)
decisions.reason: The pronoun is emphatic (m3); Japanese marks the emphasis with こそ before the verb, where the English Literal sets it off with dashes.

decisions.choice: tuvkha "あなたの恵み深さ" (L, B), "あなたは良い方" (R)
decisions.reason: God's goodness here is his kindness to the one who prays; 恵み深さ says it at Literal and Balanced, Readable follows the English "because you are good".

source.text: טוֹב־וְיָשָׁ֥ר יְהוָ֑ה עַל־כֵּ֤ן יוֹרֶ֖ה חַטָּאִ֣ים בַּדָּֽרֶךְ׃

records.literal_gloss: Good and upright [is] YHWH; therefore he teaches sinners in the way.

en.L: Good and upright [is] {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}; therefore {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} instructs sinners in the way.
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} is good and upright; that is why {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} shows sinners the way to go.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} is good and always does what is right. So {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} shows sinners the right way to live.

fr.L: Bon et droit [est] {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ; c’est pourquoi {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} instruit les pécheurs dans le chemin.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est bon et droit ; voilà pourquoi {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} montre aux pécheurs le chemin à prendre.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est bon et fait toujours ce qui est juste. Alors {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} montre aux pécheurs la bonne façon de vivre.

sw.L: Mwema na mnyofu [ni] {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}; kwa hiyo anawafundisha wenye dhambi katika njia.
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ni mwema na mnyofu; ndiyo maana anawaonyesha wenye dhambi njia ya kufuata.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ni mwema, {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} hutenda yaliyo sawa daima. Kwa hiyo anawaonyesha wenye dhambi njia sahihi ya kuishi.

es.L: Bueno y recto [es] {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}; por eso {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} instruye a los pecadores en el camino.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} es bueno y recto; por eso {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} enseña a los pecadores el camino por donde ir.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} es bueno y siempre hace lo correcto. Por eso {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} muestra a los pecadores la manera correcta de vivir.

vi.L: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} [là] tốt lành và ngay thẳng; vì vậy {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} chỉ dạy kẻ có tội trong đường lối.
vi.B: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} tốt lành và ngay thẳng; vì thế {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} chỉ cho kẻ có tội con đường phải đi.
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} tốt lành và luôn làm điều đúng. Vì vậy {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} chỉ cho người có tội cách sống đúng đắn.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}는 선하시고 정직하시니, 그러므로 그분께서 죄인들에게 길을 가르치신다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 선하시고 바르시니, 그래서 죄인들에게 갈 길을 보여 주신다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 선하시며 언제나 옳은 일을 하신다. 그래서 그분께서는 죄인들에게 바르게 사는 길을 보여 주신다.

pt.L: Bom e reto [é] {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}; por isso {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} instrui os pecadores no caminho.
pt.B: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} é bom e reto; é por isso que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} mostra aos pecadores o caminho a seguir.
pt.R: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} é bom e sempre faz o que é certo. Por isso {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} mostra aos pecadores o jeito certo de viver.

am.L: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} መልካምና ቅን [ነው]፤ ስለዚህ ኃጢአተኞችን በመንገድ ያስተምራቸዋል።
am.B: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} መልካምና ቅን ነው፤ ስለዚህ ለኃጢአተኞች የሚሄዱበትን መንገድ ያሳያቸዋል።
am.R: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} መልካም ነው፤ ሁልጊዜም ትክክል የሆነውን ያደርጋል። ስለዚህ ኃጢአተኞችን እንዴት በትክክል መኖር እንዳለባቸው ያሳያቸዋል።

hi.L: भले और सीधे [हैं] {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}; इसलिए वे पापियों को मार्ग की शिक्षा देते हैं।
hi.B: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} भले और सीधे हैं; इसी कारण वे पापियों को वह मार्ग दिखाते हैं जिस पर चलना है।
hi.R: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} भले हैं और हमेशा वही करते हैं जो सही है। इसलिए वे पापियों को जीने का सही तरीक़ा दिखाते हैं।

ru.L: Благ и праведен {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}; поэтому {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} наставляет грешников на пути.
ru.B: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} благ и праведен; вот почему {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} показывает грешникам, каким путём идти.
ru.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} добр и всегда поступает правильно. Поэтому {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} показывает грешникам, как правильно жить.

ja.L: 良く、まっすぐな方[である]、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は。それゆえ、その方は罪人たちに道を教えられる。
ja.B: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は良い方、まっすぐな方。だから、罪人たちに進むべき道を示される。
ja.R: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は良い方で、いつも正しいことをなさる。だから、罪を犯す人たちに、正しい生き方を教えてくださる。

decisions.choice: instructs: teaches, points the way
decisions.reason: The verb (yarah) means to point or direct; the word torah, instruction, comes from it. God's goodness shows itself in teaching even sinners.

decisions.choice: the LORD: the prayer turns to speak about God
decisions.reason: From here to verse 15 the psalm speaks about the LORD, before it turns back to prayer in verse 16.

decisions.choice: Verses 8-10 and 12-15 speak about the LORD in the plain written style with "나"; verses 1-7, 11 and 16-22 speak to him in 합쇼체 with "저"
decisions.reason: Here the prayer turns to speak about God (meaning decision m2); Korean follows the turns as in the other psalms of this block.

decisions.choice: वे about God
decisions.reason: The prayer turns to speak about God (m2), so the honorific third person (वे, हैं) replaces the devotional तू until verse 11.

decisions.choice: Verses 8-10, 12-14 speak about God in the third person (DNは, その方), with light respect forms (教えられる, 示される, なさる)
decisions.reason: The prayer turns to speak about God (m2) and back to him in verse 11; the Psalter's third-person convention applies.

source.text: יַדְרֵ֣ךְ עֲ֭נָוִים בַּמִּשְׁפָּ֑ט וִֽילַמֵּ֖ד עֲנָוִ֣ים דַּרְכּֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: He leads humble [ones] in the justice, and he teaches humble [ones] his way.

en.L: He leads [the] humble in what is right, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} teaches [the] humble {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} way.
en.B: He directs the lowly in what is just, and to the lowly {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} teaches {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} way.
en.R: He shows humble people how to do what is right. He teaches them how {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} wants them to live.

fr.L: Il conduit [les] humbles dans ce qui est juste, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} enseigne aux humbles {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} voie.
fr.B: Il dirige les petits dans la justice, et aux petits {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} enseigne {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} chemin.
fr.R: Il montre aux gens humbles comment faire ce qui est juste. Il leur apprend comment {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} veut qu’ils vivent.

sw.L: Anawaongoza wanyenyekevu katika yaliyo haki, na anawafundisha wanyenyekevu njia {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}.
sw.B: Anawaelekeza wanyonge katika yaliyo ya haki, na wanyonge anawafundisha njia {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}.
sw.R: Anawaonyesha watu wanyenyekevu jinsi ya kutenda yaliyo haki. Anawafundisha jinsi anavyotaka waishi.

es.L: Él guía a [los] humildes en lo que es justo, y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} enseña a [los] humildes {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} camino.
es.B: Él dirige a los humildes en lo que es justo, y a los humildes {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} les enseña {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} camino.
es.R: Él les muestra a los humildes cómo hacer lo correcto. Les enseña cómo quiere {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} que vivan.

vi.L: Ngài dẫn người khiêm nhu trong điều công chính, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} dạy người khiêm nhu đường lối của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Ngài hướng dẫn người hèn mọn trong điều công minh, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} dạy người hèn mọn đường lối {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Ngài chỉ cho những người khiêm nhường cách làm điều đúng. Ngài dạy họ biết {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} muốn họ sống thế nào.

ko.L: 그분께서 겸손한 사람들을 정의로 이끄시고, 겸손한 사람들에게 그분의 길을 가르치신다.
ko.B: 그분께서 낮은 사람들을 공의로 이끄시고, 낮은 사람들에게 그분의 길을 가르치신다.
ko.R: 그분께서는 겸손한 사람들에게 옳은 일을 하는 법을 보여 주신다. 그분께서 그들이 어떻게 살기를 원하시는지 가르쳐 주신다.

pt.L: Ele guia [os] humildes no que é justo, e {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} ensina aos humildes o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} caminho.
pt.B: Ele conduz os humildes no que é justo e ensina aos humildes o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} caminho.
pt.R: Ele mostra às pessoas humildes como fazer o que é certo. Ele as ensina a viver como {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} quer.

am.L: ትሑታንን በፍርድ ይመራቸዋል፤ ትሑታንንም መንገዱን ያስተምራቸዋል።
am.B: ትሑታንን በፍትሕ ይመራል፤ ለትሑታንም መንገዱን ያስተምራል።
am.R: ትሑታን ሰዎች ትክክል የሆነውን እንዲያደርጉ ያሳያቸዋል። እንዴት እንዲኖሩ እንደሚፈልግም ያስተምራቸዋል።

hi.L: वे नम्र लोगों की न्याय में अगुवाई करते हैं, और नम्र लोगों को अपना मार्ग सिखाते हैं।
hi.B: वे नम्र लोगों को उचित मार्ग पर ले चलते हैं, और नम्र लोगों को अपना मार्ग सिखाते हैं।
hi.R: वे नम्र लोगों को दिखाते हैं कि सही काम कैसे करें। वे उन्हें सिखाते हैं कि वे उनसे कैसा जीवन चाहते हैं।

ru.L: Он ведёт смиренных в правде и учит смиренных своему пути.
ru.B: Он направляет кротких в том, что справедливо, и учит кротких своему пути.
ru.R: Он показывает смиренным людям, как поступать правильно. Он учит их жить так, как {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} хочет.

ja.L: その方は、へりくだる者たちを公正のうちに導き、へりくだる者たちにご自分の道を教えられる。
ja.B: その方は、へりくだる者を公正に導き、へりくだる者にご自分の道を教えられる。
ja.R: その方は、へりくだる人たちに、正しいことを行う道を示し、その人たちに、どう生きてほしいかを教えてくださる。

decisions.choice: the humble: the lowly who depend on God
decisions.reason: The word ('anavim) is used of the poor and the humble, people who have no power of their own and look to God (9:19; 10:17). It is repeated for emphasis.

decisions.choice: what is right: justice
decisions.reason: The word (mishpat) is justice, the right way of acting.

decisions.choice: justice (mishpat) "ፍርድ" (L), "ፍትሕ" (B)
decisions.reason: As the terms list for mishpat.

decisions.choice: 'anavim "へりくだる者(たち)" (L, B), "へりくだる人たち" (R); bammishpat "公正のうちに" (L), "公正に" (B), "正しいことを行う道" (R)
decisions.reason: The humble are the lowly who depend on God (m1); mishpat here is justice, what is right (m2), 公正 as the Psalter's convention.

source.text: כָּל־אָרְח֣וֹת יְ֭הוָה חֶ֣סֶד וֶאֱמֶ֑ת לְנֹצְרֵ֥י בְ֝רִית֗וֹ וְעֵדֹתָֽיו׃

records.literal_gloss: All [the] paths of YHWH [are] loyal love and faithfulness for keepers of his covenant and his testimonies.

en.L: All the paths of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} [are] loyal love and faithfulness for those who keep {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} covenant and {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} testimonies.
en.B: Every path {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} takes is loyal love and faithfulness toward all who hold to {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} covenant and {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} decrees.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} always acts with faithful love and keeps {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} word to people who keep {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} covenant and obey {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} laws.

fr.L: Tous les sentiers {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} [sont] amour loyal et vérité pour ceux qui gardent {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} alliance et {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} témoignages.
fr.B: Tous les chemins que prend {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} sont amour fidèle et fidélité envers tous ceux qui s’attachent à {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} alliance et à {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} décrets.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} agit toujours avec amour fidèle et tient {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} parole envers ceux qui gardent {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} alliance et obéissent à {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} lois.

sw.L: Mapito yote ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} [ni] upendo usiokoma na uaminifu kwa wale wanaolishika agano {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} na shuhuda {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}}.
sw.B: Kila njia ambayo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} anaipita ni upendo usiokoma na uaminifu kwa wote wanaoshikamana na agano {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} na maagizo {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} daima hutenda kwa upendo usiokoma na kutimiza neno {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} kwa watu wanaoshika agano {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} na kutii sheria {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}}.

es.L: Todas las sendas {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} [son] amor leal y fidelidad para los que guardan {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pacto y {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} testimonios.
es.B: Cada senda que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} toma es amor fiel y fidelidad para todos los que se mantienen en {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pacto y {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} decretos.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} siempre actúa con amor fiel y cumple {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} palabra con los que guardan {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pacto y obedecen {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} leyes.

vi.L: Mọi nẻo đường của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} [là] tình yêu thương thành tín và sự thành tín cho những người giữ giao ước của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và các lời chứng của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Mọi con đường {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đi đều là tình yêu thương thành tín và sự thành tín đối với những ai giữ giao ước và các huấn lệnh của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} luôn hành động với tình thương không hề thay đổi và giữ lời {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã hứa với những người giữ giao ước của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và vâng theo luật lệ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 모든 길은 그분의 언약과 그분의 증언들을 지키는 사람들에게 한결같은 사랑과 신실하심이다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 가시는 모든 길은 그분의 언약과 법도를 굳게 지키는 모든 사람에게 한결같은 사랑과 신실하심이다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 그분의 언약을 지키고 그분의 법에 순종하는 사람들에게 언제나 변함없는 사랑으로 대하시고 약속을 지키신다.

pt.L: Todas as trilhas {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} [são] amor leal e fidelidade para os que guardam a {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} aliança e os {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} testemunhos.
pt.B: Todo caminho que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} percorre é amor leal e fidelidade para com todos os que se mantêm fiéis à {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} aliança e aos {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} decretos.
pt.R: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} sempre age com amor fiel e cumpre a {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} palavra com as pessoas que guardam a {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} aliança e obedecem às {{deity_pronoun:suas|Suas}} leis.

am.L: ቃል ኪዳኑንና ምስክርነቶቹን ለሚጠብቁ {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔር|የያህዌ}} ጎዳናዎች ሁሉ ጽኑ ፍቅርና ታማኝነት [ናቸው]።
am.B: ቃል ኪዳኑንና ምስክርነቶቹን አጥብቀው ለሚይዙ ሁሉ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} የሚሄድበት መንገድ ሁሉ ጽኑ ፍቅርና ታማኝነት ነው።
am.R: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ቃል ኪዳኑን ለሚጠብቁና ምስክርነቶቹን ለሚታዘዙ ሰዎች ሁልጊዜ በጽኑ ፍቅር ይሠራል፤ ቃሉንም ይጠብቅላቸዋል።

hi.L: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के सब पथ अटल प्रेम और सच्चाई [हैं], उनके लिए जो उनकी वाचा और उनकी साक्षियों का पालन करते हैं।
hi.B: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} जिस किसी पथ पर चलते हैं, वह उन सब के लिए अटल प्रेम और विश्वासयोग्यता है जो उनकी वाचा और उनके नियमों को थामे रहते हैं।
hi.R: जो लोग {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की वाचा का पालन करते हैं और उनके नियम मानते हैं, उनके साथ {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} हमेशा अटल प्रेम से व्यवहार करते हैं और अपना वचन निभाते हैं।

ru.L: Все пути {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} — неизменная любовь и верность для хранящих {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} завет и {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} свидетельства.
ru.B: Каждый путь, которым идёт {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, — это неизменная любовь и верность ко всем, кто держится {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} завета и {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} постановлений.
ru.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} всегда поступает с неизменной любовью и держит своё слово перед теми, кто хранит {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} завет и исполняет {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} законы.

ja.L: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の道筋はみな、誠実とまこと[である]、その方の契約とその方の証しを守る者たちにとって。
ja.B: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の歩まれる道はすべて、その方の契約とさとしを守る人たちへの、変わらぬいつくしみとまことだ。
ja.R: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は、ご自分の契約を守り、ご自分が示されたことに従う人たちに、いつも変わらぬいつくしみを示し、約束を守ってくださる。

decisions.choice: loyal love: love that keeps faith
decisions.reason: The word (chesed) is love that keeps its commitments. Paired with faithfulness ('emet), it echoes the LORD's own description of himself in Exodus 34:6.

decisions.choice: testimonies: the terms of the covenant
decisions.reason: The word ('edot) is the covenant's written terms, which bear witness to what God requires (19:8; Deuteronomy 4:45).

decisions.choice: the paths of the LORD: the way God deals with people
decisions.reason: Here God's paths are his own ways of acting toward those who keep his covenant.

decisions.choice: always acts with faithful love and keeps his word
alternatives: all the paths of the LORD are loyal love and faithfulness
decisions.reason: Readable says what the picture of paths means (m3), and says "keeps his word" for faithfulness.

decisions.choice: testimonies (ʿedot) "ምስክርነቶች" at every level
decisions.reason: One of the law words, kept as the Psalm 119 set in the terms list, as in Psalm 19.

decisions.choice: साक्षियाँ (L); नियम (B, R)
decisions.reason: The testimonies are the terms of the covenant (m2). Literal says साक्षी, as at 19:8, where Psalm 19 gives each word for God's teaching its own Hindi word; Balanced and Readable say नियम, as the English "decrees" and "laws".

decisions.choice: 'edot "証し" (L), "さとし" (B), "示されたこと" (R, "what he has made known"), as the Psalm 119 table
alternatives: おきて (kept for mishpatim at R)
decisions.reason: The testimonies are the terms of the covenant, God's solemn charge (m2); 証し keeps the word at Literal, さとし is the familiar word for God's charge at Balanced, and Readable says what they are. Chosen here for the rest of the Psalter.

decisions.choice: chesed ve'emet "誠実とまこと" (L), "変わらぬいつくしみとまこと" (B), Readable as the English Readable ("変わらぬいつくしみを示し、約束を守ってくださる")
decisions.reason: As the Psalter's convention for the pair.

source.text: לְמַֽעַן־שִׁמְךָ֥ יְהוָ֑ה וְֽסָלַחְתָּ֥ לַ֝עֲוֺנִ֗י כִּ֣י רַב־הֽוּא׃

records.literal_gloss: For the sake of your name, YHWH, and you will forgive my iniquity, for great [is] it.

en.L: For the sake of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, forgive my iniquity, for it [is] great.
en.B: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, for the honor of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name, forgive the wrong I have done, because it is so great.
en.R: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, forgive my sin, because it is very great. Do it to show what kind of God {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} are.

fr.L: À cause de {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} nom, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, pardonne ma faute, car elle [est] grande.
fr.B: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, pour l’honneur de {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} nom, pardonne le mal que j’ai fait, car il est si grand.
fr.R: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, pardonne mon péché, parce qu’il est très grand. Fais-le pour montrer quel Dieu {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} es.

sw.L: Kwa ajili ya jina {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}}, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, unisamehe uovu wangu, kwa maana [ni] mkubwa.
sw.B: Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kwa heshima ya jina {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}}, unisamehe kosa nililotenda, kwa sababu ni kubwa mno.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, unisamehe dhambi yangu, kwa sababu ni kubwa sana. Fanya hivyo ili kuonyesha {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} ni Mungu wa namna gani.

es.L: Por causa de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nombre, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, perdona mi iniquidad, porque [es] grande.
es.B: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, por la honra de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nombre, perdona el mal que he hecho, porque es muy grande.
es.R: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, perdona mi pecado, porque es muy grande. Hazlo para mostrar qué clase de Dios eres {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}}.

vi.L: Vì cớ danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, xin tha thứ tội lỗi tôi, vì nó lớn lắm.
vi.B: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, vì danh dự của danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, xin tha thứ điều sai trái tôi đã làm, vì nó quá lớn.
vi.R: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, xin tha thứ tội lỗi tôi, vì tội tôi rất lớn. Xin làm điều đó để cho thấy {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là Đức Chúa Trời như thế nào.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 주님의 이름을 위하여 제 죄악을 용서해 주십시오. 그것이 크기 때문입니다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 주님의 이름의 영광을 위하여 제가 저지른 잘못을 용서해 주십시오. 그 잘못이 너무 큽니다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 제 죄를 용서해 주십시오. 제 죄가 너무 큽니다. 주님께서 어떤 하나님이신지 보여 주시려고 그렇게 해 주십시오.

pt.L: Pela honra do {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} nome, {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, perdoa a minha iniquidade, porque grande [é] ela.
pt.B: {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, pela honra do {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} nome, perdoa o mal que eu fiz, porque é muito grande.
pt.R: {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, perdoa o meu pecado, porque ele é muito grande. Faz isso para mostrar que tipo de Deus {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} és.

am.L: ስለ ስምህ፣ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ በደሌን ይቅር በል፤ ታላቅ ነውና።
am.B: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ ለስምህ ክብር ስትል የሠራሁትን በደል ይቅር በል፤ እጅግ ታላቅ ነውና።
am.R: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ ኃጢአቴ እጅግ ታላቅ ነውና ይቅር በለኝ። ምን ዓይነት አምላክ እንደ ሆንክ ለማሳየት ይህን አድርግ።

hi.L: हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, अपने नाम के कारण मेरा अधर्म क्षमा कर, क्योंकि वह बड़ा [है]।
hi.B: हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, अपने नाम के आदर के लिए मेरा दोष क्षमा कर, क्योंकि वह बहुत बड़ा है।
hi.R: हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, मेरा पाप क्षमा कर, क्योंकि वह बहुत बड़ा है। ऐसा करके दिखा दे कि तू कैसा परमेश्वर है।

ru.L: Ради {{deity_pronoun:твоего|Твоего}} имени, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, прости беззаконие моё, ведь оно велико.
ru.B: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, ради чести {{deity_pronoun:твоего|Твоего}} имени прости зло, которое я сделал, потому что оно так велико.
ru.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, прости мой грех, потому что он очень велик. Сделай это, чтобы показать, какой {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} Бог.

ja.L: あなたの名のゆえに、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}よ、わたしの咎を赦してください。それは大きいのだから。
ja.B: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}よ、あなたの名の誉れのために、わたしの犯した咎を赦してください。それは、あまりにも大きいのだから。
ja.R: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}よ、わたしの罪をゆるしてください。それは、とても大きいのだから。あなたがどのような神であるかを示すために、そうしてください。

decisions.choice: for the sake of your name: for your own honor
decisions.reason: God's name is his character as he has made it known; to act for its sake is to act true to himself (23:3; Ezekiel 36:22).

decisions.choice: forgive: a request
decisions.reason: The verb form, joined by "and", carries on the plea of the verses before.

decisions.choice: for it is great: the reason for the plea
decisions.reason: The word ki usually gives a reason: the guilt is too great for anyone but God to deal with. Some read it as "though".

decisions.choice: Do it to show what kind of God you are
alternatives: for the sake of your name
decisions.reason: Readable says what the idiom means (m1).

decisions.choice: salach "赦す" (L, B), "ゆるす" (R); 'avon "咎" (L, B), "罪" (R)
decisions.reason: Forgive is 赦す (L, B), ゆるす (R), as the style guide; 咎 keeps 'avon apart from chatta't (罪) where Literal and Balanced can.

source.text: מִי־זֶ֣ה הָ֭אִישׁ יְרֵ֣א יְהוָ֑ה י֝וֹרֶ֗נּוּ בְּדֶ֣רֶךְ יִבְחָֽר׃

records.literal_gloss: Who [is] this, the man fearing YHWH? He will teach him in [the] way he will choose.

en.L: Who [is] {{gender:the person|the man}} who fears {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}? He will instruct {{gender:them|him}} in the way {{gender:they|he}} should choose.
en.B: Is there anyone who fears {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}? He will show that person which way to choose.
en.R: What about people who respect {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}? He will teach them the right path to choose.

fr.L: Qui [est] {{gender:l’être humain|l’homme}} qui craint {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ? Il l’instruira dans la voie qu’il doit choisir.
fr.B: Y a-t-il quelqu’un qui craint {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ? Il lui montrera quel chemin choisir.
fr.R: Et ceux qui respectent {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ? Il leur apprendra quel bon chemin choisir.

sw.L: Ni nani mtu yule amchaye {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}? Atamfundisha katika njia atakayoichagua.
sw.B: Je, yuko mtu yeyote amchaye {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}? Atamwonyesha mtu huyo njia ya kuchagua.
sw.R: Na je, watu wanaomheshimu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kwa hofu takatifu? Atawafundisha njia sahihi ya kuchagua.

es.L: ¿Quién [es] {{gender:la persona|el hombre}} que teme {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}? Él le enseñará el camino que ha de escoger.
es.B: ¿Hay alguien que tema {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}? Él le mostrará qué camino escoger.
es.R: ¿Y la gente que respeta {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}? Él le enseñará el buen camino que debe escoger.

vi.L: Ai [là] người kính sợ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}? Ngài sẽ chỉ dạy người ấy con đường người ấy nên chọn.
vi.B: Có ai kính sợ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} không? Ngài sẽ chỉ cho người ấy con đường phải chọn.
vi.R: Còn những người tôn kính {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} thì sao? Ngài sẽ dạy họ con đường đúng để chọn.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 경외하는 그 사람은 누구인가? 그분께서 그가 택할 길을 그에게 가르치실 것이다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 경외하는 사람이 있는가? 그분께서 그 사람에게 어느 길을 택해야 할지 보여 주실 것이다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 두려운 마음으로 섬기는 사람들은 어떠한가? 그분께서 그들이 택할 바른길을 가르쳐 주실 것이다.

pt.L: Quem [é] {{gender:a pessoa|o homem}} que teme {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}? Ele lhe ensinará o caminho que deve escolher.
pt.B: Há alguém que teme {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}? Ele mostrará a essa pessoa que caminho escolher.
pt.R: E as pessoas que respeitam {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}? Ele vai ensinar a elas o caminho certo que devem escolher.

am.L: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} የሚፈራ ሰው ማን ነው? በሚመርጠው መንገድ ያስተምረዋል።
am.B: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} የሚፈራ ሰው አለን? የትኛውን መንገድ እንደሚመርጥ እርሱ ያሳየዋል።
am.R: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} የሚያከብሩ ሰዎችስ? የሚመርጡትን ትክክለኛ መንገድ ያስተምራቸዋል።

hi.L: वह व्यक्ति कौन [है] जो {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} का भय मानता है? वे उसे उस मार्ग की शिक्षा देंगे जिसे उसे चुनना चाहिए।
hi.B: क्या कोई है जो {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} का भय मानता है? वे उस व्यक्ति को दिखाएँगे कि कौन-सा मार्ग चुने।
hi.R: जो लोग {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} का आदर और भय मानते हैं, उनका क्या? वे उन्हें सिखाएँगे कि कौन-सा सही रास्ता चुनें।

ru.L: Кто тот человек, что боится {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}? Он наставит его на путь, который тот должен избрать.
ru.B: Есть ли кто-нибудь, кто боится {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}? Он покажет такому человеку, какой путь выбрать.
ru.R: А как же люди, которые почитают {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}? Он научит их, какой правильный путь выбрать.

ja.L: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}を恐れる人とは、だれか？その方は、その人が選ぶべき道を、その人に教えられる。
ja.B: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}を畏れる人はいるだろうか？その方は、その人に、選ぶべき道を示される。
ja.R: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}をおそれ敬う人は、どうだろう？その方は、その人たちに、選ぶべき正しい道を教えてくださる。

decisions.choice: fears the LORD: honors him with reverence and obeys him
decisions.reason: To fear the LORD is to take him seriously, honoring and obeying him (111:10; Proverbs 1:7). It is not terror.

decisions.choice: he should choose: the person chooses the way
decisions.reason: "He will choose" may refer to the person, who is taught which way to choose, or to God, who teaches the way he himself has chosen.

decisions.choice: the man: anyone who fears the LORD
decisions.reason: The word (ha'ish) is a type of person, as in 1:1; anyone who fears the LORD.

decisions.choice: the person, them, they; with "the man", "him", "he" as the alternative
decisions.reason: The person is anyone who fears the LORD (m3).

decisions.choice: {{gender:la persona|el hombre}}; le
decisions.reason: The Hebrew "the man" means anyone who fears the LORD, so Literal has "la persona" by default with "el hombre" as the alternative, as the English does. The pronoun after it is "le", which Spanish uses for a man or a woman, so it does not need to change with the setting.

decisions.choice: "người", "người ấy" with no gender spans (verses 12-13)
alternatives: gender spans as in the English
decisions.reason: As in Psalms 1 and 15, "người" and "người ấy" fit a man or a woman, so the setting has no second Vietnamese form.

decisions.choice: a pessoa, with "o homem" as the alternative; "lhe" and "deve" with no setting
decisions.reason: As the English, the noun is under the gender setting. The English needs further spans for "them/him" and "they/he"; Portuguese "lhe" and the verb "deve" do not show sex, so they need none, and "deve escolher" keeps open who chooses, as the Hebrew does (m2).

decisions.choice: "ሰው" (a person) and the generic masculine forms with no gender span, here and in verse 13
alternatives: gender spans, as the English Literal
decisions.reason: "ሰው" and the generic masculine suffix already include women and men, so Amharic has one wording (docs/amharic-style.md 7b).

decisions.choice: वह व्यक्ति, no gender span
decisions.reason: The English Literal offers "the person / them" with "the man / him" as the alternative. Hindi व्यक्ति is anyone, man or woman, so the Hindi has no span; the same holds in verse 13.

decisions.choice: प्रभु का भय मानना (L, B); आदर और भय मानना (R)
decisions.reason: The fear of the LORD is reverence that obeys (m1): Literal and Balanced say भय मानना, Readable आदर और भय मानना, the wording settled for the Psalms.

decisions.choice: "человек ... его ... тот", no gender span
alternatives: a span like the English "the person / the man"
decisions.reason: "Человек" means any person, man or woman, as in the New Testament in this translation, so Russian has no second wording for the gender setting to choose.

decisions.choice: ha'ish "人", "その人" with no gender span, where the English Literal has {{gender:the person|the man}}, {{gender:them|him}}, {{gender:they|he}}
decisions.reason: Japanese 人 already means anyone, man or woman (m3), so no span is needed.

source.text: נַ֭פְשׁוֹ בְּט֣וֹב תָּלִ֑ין וְ֝זַרְע֗וֹ יִ֣ירַשׁ אָֽרֶץ׃

records.literal_gloss: His soul in good will lodge, and his offspring will possess [the] land.

en.L: {{gender:Their|His}} soul will lodge in good, and {{gender:their|his}} offspring will possess [the] land.
en.B: They will live their lives in well-being, and their descendants will possess the land.
en.R: They will have good lives, and their children will own the land after them.

fr.L: Son âme logera dans le bonheur, et sa descendance possédera [le] pays.
fr.B: Ces gens vivront dans le bien-être, et leurs descendants posséderont le pays.
fr.R: Ils auront une bonne vie, et leurs enfants posséderont le pays après eux.

sw.L: Nafsi yake itakaa katika mema, na uzao wake utairithi nchi.
sw.B: Wataishi maisha yao katika hali njema, na wazao wao wataimiliki nchi.
sw.R: Watakuwa na maisha mazuri, na watoto wao wataimiliki nchi baada yao.

es.L: Su alma morará en el bien, y su descendencia poseerá [la] tierra.
es.B: Vivirán su vida en bienestar, y sus descendientes poseerán la tierra.
es.R: Tendrán una buena vida, y sus hijos serán dueños de la tierra después de ellos.

vi.L: Linh hồn người ấy sẽ ở trong sự tốt lành, và dòng dõi người ấy sẽ sở hữu đất.
vi.B: Họ sẽ sống trong phước hạnh, và dòng dõi họ sẽ được làm chủ đất đai.
vi.R: Họ sẽ có cuộc sống tốt đẹp, và con cái họ sẽ được hưởng đất đai sau họ.

ko.L: 그의 영혼은 좋은 것 가운데 머물고, 그의 자손은 땅을 차지할 것이다.
ko.B: 그들은 평안 가운데 살고, 그들의 자손은 땅을 차지할 것이다.
ko.R: 그들은 좋은 삶을 살 것이고, 그들의 자녀들은 그들의 뒤를 이어 땅을 차지할 것이다.

pt.L: A sua alma pousará no bem, e a sua descendência possuirá a terra.
pt.B: Essas pessoas viverão a vida em bem-estar, e os seus descendentes possuirão a terra.
pt.R: Elas terão uma vida boa, e os seus filhos serão donos da terra depois delas.

am.L: ነፍሱ በመልካም ታድራለች፤ ዘሩም ምድርን ይወርሳል።
am.B: ሕይወታቸውን በደኅንነት ይኖራሉ፤ ዘሮቻቸውም ምድሪቱን ይወርሳሉ።
am.R: መልካም ሕይወት ይኖራቸዋል፤ ከእነርሱም በኋላ ልጆቻቸው ምድሪቱን ይወርሳሉ።

hi.L: उसका प्राण भलाई में बसेगा, और उसका वंश देश का अधिकारी होगा।
hi.B: वे अपना जीवन कुशल से बिताएँगे, और उनकी सन्तान देश की अधिकारी होगी।
hi.R: उनका जीवन अच्छा बीतेगा, और उनके बाद उनके बच्चे उस देश के मालिक होंगे।

ru.L: Душа его пребудет в добре, и потомство его наследует землю.
ru.B: Они будут жить в благополучии, и их потомки получат во владение землю.
ru.R: У них будет хорошая жизнь, и их дети после них получат эту землю.

ja.L: その人の魂は良いもののうちに宿り、その子孫は地を受け継ぐ。
ja.B: そのような人たちは幸せに暮らし、その子孫は地を受け継ぐ。
ja.R: その人たちは良い生活を送り、その子どもたちは、あとでその土地を自分のものにする。

decisions.choice: his soul will lodge in good: he will live in well-being
decisions.reason: The verb (lin) means to spend the night, to stay; the person will rest in what is good, in plenty and peace.

decisions.choice: will possess the land: the promise to the faithful
decisions.reason: The land was promised to Abraham's offspring (Genesis 15:7); Psalm 37 repeats that the humble and righteous will possess it (37:9, 11, 29).

decisions.choice: they, their
decisions.reason: The Hebrew speaks of the person of verse 12 as "he"; Balanced and Readable use the plural, which includes men and women alike.

decisions.choice: their, with "his" as the alternative
decisions.reason: As in verse 12.

decisions.choice: a sua alma, a sua descendência, with no gender setting
decisions.reason: The English needs a span for "their/his". The Portuguese possessive "sua" agrees with the thing possessed and says nothing about the owner's sex, so there is nothing to choose.

decisions.choice: "его", no gender span
decisions.reason: Literal follows the Hebrew singular "his", which in Russian refers back to "человек" of verse 12, a word for anyone; a plural "их" would not agree with it, so there is no span.

decisions.choice: nafsho betov talin "その人の魂は良いもののうちに宿り" (L), "幸せに暮らし" (B), "良い生活を送り" (R); no gender span
decisions.reason: To lodge in good is to live in well-being (m1); the English "their" span becomes その人 / その人たち.

source.text: ס֣וֹד יְ֭הוָה לִירֵאָ֑יו וּ֝בְרִית֗וֹ לְהוֹדִיעָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: [The] counsel of YHWH [is] for those fearing him, and his covenant, to make them know.

en.L: The counsel of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} [is] for those who fear {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, and {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} covenant, to make [it] known to them.
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} takes those who fear {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} into {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} confidence; {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} lets them know {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} covenant.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} is a close friend to people who honor {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. He shows them what {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} covenant means.

fr.L: Le secret {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} [est] pour ceux qui {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} craignent, et {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} alliance, pour la leur faire connaître.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} fait de ceux qui {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} craignent {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} confidents ; {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} leur fait connaître {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} alliance.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est un ami proche pour ceux qui {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}honorent. Il leur montre ce que veut dire {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} alliance.

sw.L: Shauri la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} [ni] kwa wale wamchao, na agano {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}}, kuwajulisha.
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} huwafanya wale wamchao kuwa wasiri {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}; huwajulisha agano {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}}.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ni rafiki wa karibu wa watu wanaomheshimu. Anawaonyesha maana ya agano {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}}.

es.L: El consejo íntimo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} [es] para los que {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} temen, y {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pacto, para dárselo a conocer.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} trata como amigos de confianza a los que {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} temen; {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} les da a conocer {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pacto.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} es un amigo cercano de los que {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} honran. Les muestra lo que significa {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pacto.
